article.story: FARMVILLE, Va. -- — Jaylen Benard’s 26 points helped Longwood defeat VMI 82-76 on Wednesday. Benard shot 8 of 12 from the field, including 5 for 8 from 3-point range, and went 5 for 6 from the line for the Lancers (4-2). M.J. Williams added 16 points while shooting 5 for 7 (3 for 5 from 3-point range) and 3 of 5 from the free-throw line while they also had seven rebounds. T.J. Robinson shot 4 for 8 (0 for 3 from 3-point range) and 7 of 10 from the free-throw line to finish with 15 points for Longwood. Rickey Bradley finished with 18 points, seven rebounds, seven assists and two steals for the Keydets (3-3). T.J. Johnson added 16 points for VMI. Rokas Zilys finished with 12 points. Up next Both teams play on Saturday. Longwood visits East Tennessee State and VMI hosts Gardner-Webb. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
